notes.title: Give old sports facilities a second life! Sports: Renovations announced
notes.content:
What happens when a sports game meets a house renovator? A game where you renovate old sports facilities! 

Restore the glory of sports in a relaxing renovator sim, made by Goat Gamez, a studio founded by Movie Games and Robert Lewandowski!

Wishlist the game now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

How do you save your beloved team’s court from being torn down by a real estate developer? You do what you do best – renovate dilapidated sports facilities to collect the money you need to help out.

Restore gyms, courts, pools and pitches to their former glory, upgrade your tools and expand your headquarters. Collect trophies and mementoes during your renovation missions and display them proudly in a special room for everyone to see.

FEATURES:

Two game modes: Campaign with a predefined number of levels and storyline.
Buy new tools and upgrade the equipment you already own.
Earn money on your renovation jobs and use it to expand your own base of operations – each room unlocked will add some perks and some of the rooms come with a side mission.
Buy cosmetic items you can place around your office.
Trophy room where the player sees various memorabilia collected during renovation missions.

Are you ready to give sports facilities a second chance?

notes.title: Wellington Update has launched!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/348137d049166406d917c68e4b57977d74efad32.jpg

Mechanics!

Prepare your tools and get ready for a long awaited new update! This time we’ve prepared for you something big! We’ve not only squashed over 1000 bugs in existing content, but we’ve also implemented fixes to recently known issues, made some improvements and added new features, including a brand new plane - Vickers Wellington. We’ve decided to change the name from Summer Update to Wellington Update to make the name more suitable to its most important content.

But it’s not the end of changes in Plane Mechanic Simulator! We have decided to bring back some of the features you all loved so much - manual tools, which are available in the Expert Mode and the Clipboard!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/22d16fd6c226f5bc0b1d73f69ae2739299f43a4a.jpg

About new aircraft: Vickers Wellington is a British two-engine WWII bomber, built at the Vickers-Armstrong plant. It was the primary British long-range night bomber of the first years of war in Great Britain. The designers were Rex K. Pearson and Barnes Wallis. The first mass-produced Wellington Mk I aircraft took off the ground on 23 December 1937 and was manufactured until October 1945.

The update also includes new WW2 stylized UI and full support for Xbox and PlayStation controllers!

Here’s a full list of fixes, changes, and new implementations to Plane Mechanic Simulator:
- new WW2 stylized UI 
- full gamepad support
- new plane Vickers Wellington
- over 1000 bug fixes and tweaks to existing content
- expert mode with manual tools for hardcore players
- new hint system
- return of the clipboard

The update launches right now, and we’ve already started working on the new one. We also want to thank you for your suggestions which made us rethink our plans for the game and set the new priorities. Look out for our future announcements, and see you in hangars!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/c074914766e4904d963f60be3f1d99caab5fbe14.png

Over and out!
Movie Games & Cobble Games

notes.title: Supplement to the upcoming Summer Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/b7ef0fca14ae9c02d6bfd2a8f1fd2b38d48ee521.jpg

Mechanics,

As you've already read in the last article, we’re continuously working on the next update, that we officially name it as Summer Update.

We’ve brought you a full list of upcoming changes and updates, but during the development, we’ve discovered a few in-game things that need our attention. They have to be implemented with the closest update, so this means that it’ll include more changes than we expected, but it’ll take a bit more time. 

That doesn’t mean, of course, that the update will launch in some long-time date! Summer Update is on its final straightforward and you should get it sooner than you think ;)

Also, we want to thank you for all your feedback and support in improving the Plane Mechanic Simulator. If we already changed or fixed some game’s content and you feel that there’s something that again needs our attention, feel free to let us know about it! This also applies to the changes that we didn’t make yet :)

Stay tuned and look out for the upcoming Summer Update! We’ll inform you about its release and give you a full list of implementations on launch.

See you in hangars!

Movie Games & Cobble Games

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/e5df44fb62276d3b012b7ace2e60acb0f82a6314.jpg

notes.title: UI Update is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/1fb9a6d6aa69158962bba965abb684e57e84e4a6.jpg

Hi Mechanics!

The expansion and improving of Plane Mechanic Simulator continues! This time, we’ve brought you an update for the User Interface!


It's time to improve the current UI to make it better from the previous one. What’s the most important - the paper pages have been changed - now their design is a bit more modern than before.

Let’s start with the main menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/108f766e5c97f51c0c81a118e4c4d59d4bb54b70.jpg

Gameplay:

The clipboard from the menu has been replaced with a more simple UI. All modes and interactions, like moving the ladder or refilling the fuel, are now accessible through the selection wheel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/209daaf5fa080d81591f6059ee68f4613fd7147e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/48dc7d6da191ac0e49f65c1615f64306b4b3ccb7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/0c3a3647638ba08f6ac2fcb801fcb0a62293fac9.jpg

The update also includes fixes to the currently appearing issues. Here’s a summary of the implemented changes and fixes that will be accessible in the update. The list will be also available in the changelog:

Full Interface Rework: 
- added modern-looking User Interface 
- added new context wheel menus to simplify the tools using
- added docking places for ladders 
- changed fueling system 
- changed oiling system 

Fixed bugs: 
- added missing tools in some hangar scenes 
- fixed issue with removing radio without opening a hatch in Hawker Hurricane 
- fixed game crash after earning more than 3500 merit points


Our work is not finished, and soon you can count on an update with a brand new aircraft! Stay tuned and share your impressions on the new interface with us!

We also remind you that you can still share with us your ideas about missions and malfunctions, which you would like to face in the upcoming Bristol Blenheim!

See you in the base,

Plane Mechanic Simulator Team

notes.title: Hurricane Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/72dc7bc5f57d87eda615eb916e6dded6db7dc3ba.jpg

Hello, fellow mechanics!

The works on Plane Mechanic Simulator continues, but we're not here to talk only about the obvious stuff! It's time for a new machine to fly into our hangars! 

Our enemies don’t stop with their preparations and that forces us to strengthen our defenses. The Royal Air Force is expanding. It  means not only more quantity of already known machines, but there’s also the delivery of a brand new plane make and model!


Introducing Hawker Hurricane MK1!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/be1f7c51160152046c8d4d1cf6ae1ce0d5382d06.png

The British single-seat fighter, made by Hawker Aircraft Ltd. was one of the most recognizable aircraft from World War II. It was produced in the years 1937-1944 and played a significant role during the Battle of Britain in 1940. Hawker Hurricane was developed in several versions from ground fighters to Sea Hurricane, which was able to operate from ships.

Hawker Hurricane flies into our ranks with a pack of 14 new missions and it’s up to you to prepare this plane to be ready to strike any moment ! The update also includes several fixes for various in-game bugs and issues. 

On a side note: 
You, our loyal players, brought to our attention that bringing the mandatory timer feature which has been implemented in the previous update, was not the best idea… so we made the time optional yet again. We are deeply sorry for any inconveniences caused by our overlooking and we promise it won’t happen again.  Also we are always open to any of your constructive feedback so feel free to participate in our Steam Forums. We want to know what your opinion is. In the end, We make this game for you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895229/d1b65dc5e7de7c816ef828ba5d885c9e5b7b6d9e.png

The next new content is on its way! Keep an eye on the upcoming announcements and see you in base!

Over and out!
Movie Games & Cobble Games
